instruction: Use command-line automation with the installed SOLIDWORKS CAM 2025 environment (CAMWorks technology); do not use GUI clicks, generic G-code generators, or manual .nc editing/copying. Before starting the work, SOLIDWORKS CAM/CAMWorks is hosted by `C:\Program Files\SOLIDWORKS Corp\SOLIDWORKS\SLDWORKS.exe`; run the native CAM automation through that installation. Load C:\Users\User\Desktop\quality_part.step and read C:\Users\User\Desktop\params.json. Use G54 at the model top-face center [0, 0, 18] mm with the tool axis along -Z. Machine the actual imported geometry in this order: T1 clears the 10 mm-deep upper irregular pocket formed by the union of the left and central regions; T2 clears the central rectangular region a further 1 mm to Z=-11; T3 drills the four D5 through holes at (±30, ±20); and T4 machines the 120 x 80 mm outside contour through 18 mm. Use each operation's specified tool diameter, spindle speed, and primary cutting/drilling feed. Set program number 2032 and save the native posted NC output exactly as C:\Users\User\Desktop\task-12.nc.
